page.layout: Running head top left, page number top right. One column of names in a ruled table, with years at the left of each group. Margin notes in the right margin, beside 1318, 1319 and 1323. Below the table: signature "T 4" at left and catchword "Ludul" at right.

main_text.l: 1318 | Ioannes Poder. Pacta Groning-cum Ostergois. Terræ motus.
1319 | Iacobus Buning. Hi etiam Ratio-nales appellantur in literis eisdem[?].
1323 | Iacobus Buning. Pugna Frisiorum contra Geldrum. Decretum Vp-stalesbom[?]. celebre.

page.notes: The ink blot over the end of the note beside 1319 obscures "eisdem", read as "eisdem[?]". "Groning-cum" in the note beside 1318: the mark after "Groning" may be a dot, not a hyphen; I have read it as a hyphen. "Wijç" in the 1319 line is doubtful. "Vp-stalesbom" in the note beside 1323 is doubtful; "stalefbom" was read with the long s as plain s. The left-hand years are printed in old-style figures and copied as printed.
